description: This file defines interfaces and constants for managing flash memory operations, including sector management, erasing, reading, writing, and error codes, specifically for STM32 microcontrollers.

methods.name: flashSectorSize
methods.description: Returns the size in bytes of a specified flash sector.

methods.name: flashSectorBegin
methods.description: Returns the starting address of a specified flash sector.

methods.name: flashSectorEnd
methods.description: Returns the end address (exclusive) of a specified flash sector.

methods.name: flashSectorAt
methods.description: Determines which sector contains a given address.

methods.name: flashErase
methods.description: Erases a span of flash memory starting at a given address.

methods.name: flashIsErased
methods.description: Checks if a span of flash memory is erased.

methods.name: flashCompare
methods.description: Compares flash memory content with a buffer.

methods.name: flashRead
methods.description: Reads data from flash memory into a buffer.

methods.name: flashWrite
methods.description: Writes data from a buffer into flash memory.
